purpose: Inspect a requested axial/azimuth rectangle on one certified label parcel, including cuts across the seam. A smaller detached receipt is not a new global certification, physical defect measurement, or redaction.
trust: Index producer must verify the complete externally pinned original parcel and independently bind both full payload hashes while constructing row-block hashes. Reader must receive trusted index and parcel digests and the desired query coordinates independently of a receipt. Same bytes authenticated and decoded; no use of directory content as a trust root.

query.coordinates: zero-based axial start, azimuth start, axial extent, angular extent; finite height, circular columns; no more than one turn
query.label_convention: retain global canonical IDs; do not renumber within the rectangle; absent area is not unknown
required_output: ordered mask and int32 little-endian crop SHA-256
below, observed and unknown cell counts
per-ID observed cell counts inside rectangle
authenticated row coverage and requested cell count

bounds.detached_verifier_dependencies: Python standard library only (-I -S); no network, source, NumPy/SciPy, CUDA or full payloads

qualification.independent_oracle: Compare ordered crop digests, counts and positive IDs to direct indexed NumPy crops of every original dense map; cover entire map by disjoint windows and test a one-cell sample
negative_controls: invalid axial wrap or repeated azimuth
same-length alteration outside asserted band does not falsely certify the whole parcel
